title: A Metric Mix-Up Left A Plane 24,600 Pounds Short
hook: One unit mistake left a plane without enough fuel.
closing: A wrong unit can destroy machinery or endanger people, so conversions deserve real attention.
question: Should everyone use metric?

segments.say: Only 5% of people live where metric is not official, making cross-system mistakes unusually concentrated.
Mixed units dropped NASA's Mars orbiter to 57 kilometers, sending the spacecraft dangerously below its planned path.
The jet received just 20,400 pounds of fuel, then ran dry mid-flight and had to glide down.
